parole.testo: Attested in Old Hungarian as yiro (i:ro) with the same meaning, from Old Chuvash *ï̄raɣ, from Oghur *ayraɣ (whence also Khalkha Mongolian айраг (ajrag),) ultimately from Proto-Turkic *ayran (see it for more). Compare Eastern Mari йыра (jyra), Chuvash уйран (ujran), Russian урень (urenʹ), Bashkir айр
